wirelessRGUs.label: Wireless subscriptions (thousands)

fixedRGUs.label: Fixed RGUs (thousands)

notes: Subscribers come from the 20-F's RGU table by reportable segment (thousands). Mexico, Brazil, Colombia and Argentina are single-country segments and appear as country rows; multi-country segments are regions whose country lists are the 20-F's own segment definitions. Employees are reported only for Mexico and four broad regions (South America, Central America, Caribbean, Europe), which the filing does not define by country, so those region rows carry no country list. Because each quote covers one table row, each country or region appears once per metric (wireless RGUs, fixed RGUs, employees); merge rows by iso2/name when displaying. Wireless and fixed RGUs should not be summed into customers (one customer can hold several RGUs). Periods are December 31, 2025 (FY2025 20-F); the reportable segments and their country lists are unchanged from the FY2024 20-F. No U.S. state data or taxes-by-country report was found in the 20-F.
